Alex Morgan | First working day October 19, 2026. Complete the People Portal profile by October 15. Payroll
payment preference is due October 20; the employee enters it directly in the secure portal.
Dependencies
Profile verification releases the screening invitation. Laptop setup must finish before the virtual welcome
session. Do not mark downstream tasks complete merely because the prerequisite is complete.

Profile verification, screening clearance, employment-verification paperwork, payroll preference, laptop setup
and orientation attendance are separate tasks. The same task may be mentioned in several reminder emails.
Unknown details
The laptop appointment time and location are not yet assigned. Ask Orbit IT to confirm them. Benefits
election remains a separate task due November 17.
